hints.title: Zero Handling and Division Obstacle
hints.text: Computing the product of all elements and dividing by each entry fails when zeros are present, and the problem prohibits division. How can you decompose the product excluding position i into two independent pieces?

hints.title: Prefix and Suffix Factorization
hints.text: The product of all elements except index i is equal to the product of all elements to the left of i multiplied by the product of all elements to the right of i.

hints.title: Two-Pass Forward and Backward In-Place Scan
hints.text: Initialize the output array with prefix products accumulated from left to right. Then iterate backward from the end, maintaining a running suffix product and multiplying it into the corresponding position of the output array.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def productExceptSelf(self, nums: list[int]) -> list[int]:
        n = len(nums)
        res = [1] * n
        prefix = 1
        for i in range(n):
            res[i] = prefix
            prefix *= nums[i]
        suffix = 1
        for i in range(n - 1, -1, -1):
            res[i] *= suffix
            suffix *= nums[i]
        return res
```

variables: N: length of nums array (2 <= N <= 10^5)
complexity.notes: Two passes over nums using only the output array and O(1) extra scalar accumulators.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Computing product of all other elements for each index with nested loops takes O(N^2) time. For N = 10^5, this takes 10^10 operations, far exceeding the time limit. Using total division fails on zero elements and is prohibited.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Building prefix products directly inside the output array and using a single scalar for suffix products reduces auxiliary space from O(N) to O(1) while maintaining O(N) linear time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Respecting the no-division constraint, handling multiple zeros correctly, achieving O(1) extra space beyond the result array, and writing clean two-pass logic.
